object.content:
I made a change to my MSP430 Reaction Game project (http://tinkeringetc.blogspot.com/p/msp430-reaction-game.html) that I have been wanting to do for a while. I added the ability to restart the game with a different speed or the same speed after the game has been finished. I only had to change the delayTime variable into a global variable and add the ability to restart with either option after the game has ended. You can view the changed code at https://github.com/dwaq/MSP430-Reaction-Game/blob/master/MSP430-Reaction-Game.c .

Below is a flow chart of how the game is played on the circuit board. I thought a visual of how the game works would help people better understand the gameplay. I created the chart using www.lucidchart.com and it came out even better than I was expecting using a free online tool.

If anybody is interested in the project, check out my blog above (the first link) and comment if you have any questions. Also, I still have a bunch of PCBs available if anybody would like to build their own.
